memories.title: Claude hooks
memories.body: Claude Code SessionStart and UserPromptSubmit hooks inject context; SessionEnd ingests the session transcript. The installer also adds scope guidance to CLAUDE.md.

memories.title: Transcript episode
memories.body: The transcript hook normalizes harness turns, stores dated JSONL and metadata, and creates an episode page with a transcript_ref. Provenance can trace a node back to that session.
memories.evidence: an episode page links back to the transcript

memories.title: Hook injection
memories.body: The push layer runs at session start and on prompts to inject relevant memories without waiting for a model tool call.
memories.evidence: MCP tools alone depend on the model choosing to call them

memories.title: Write scope
memories.body: MCP memory writes require an explicit global or project scope. Workspace architecture, conventions, and decisions belong to project scope; ambiguous facts default to project.

memories.title: Derived project identity
memories.body: When project scope is selected without an ID, the CLI or MCP server derives an opaque project identity from its working directory. The readable folder name is only a locator.
memories.evidence: working directory of the CLI or MCP server process

memories.title: Project recall filter
memories.body: Project recall requires the same opaque project_id used for project writes; it searches that namespace. Unqualified recall searches across all memory.
memories.evidence: use the same scope and id to recall only that project

memories.title: Markdown source truth
memories.body: Markdown pages under the data directory are durable source of truth. SQLite FTS5 and run logs are derived state, so losing the index must not lose memory pages.
memories.evidence: Markdown pages are the source of truth

memories.title: Index rebuild
memories.body: IndexManager mirrors Markdown pages into SQLite. The rebuild-index command reconstructs derived SQLite state from the pages after an index failure.

memories.title: Verify checks
memories.body: memex verify checks page parsing, index freshness, links, and optional recall and write activity evidence; CI can fail when evidence is missing.

memories.title: Five MCP tools
memories.body: The stdio MCP server exposes write, recall, consolidate, forget, and provenance as model-facing tools with typed schemas.

memories.title: Operator CLI commands
memories.body: Manual transcript ingestion, transcript cleanup, JSON import, and JSON export remain CLI operations outside the MCP agent tool list.
memories.evidence: manual ingestion, transcript cleanup, import, and export remain CLI commands

memories.title: Shared facade
memories.body: The Memex application facade orchestrates the store, index, retriever, links, transcript hook, archive, and import/export. CLI and MCP adapters use the same services and domain types.
memories.evidence: `Memex` is both the public Python API and the composition root

memories.title: Consolidation request
memories.body: Consolidation is the only LLM-calling operation and runs only when explicitly requested. Dry-run proposes changes without writing; full mode distills episodes into durable pages.
memories.evidence: Consolidation is the only operation that needs an LLM

memories.title: Secret scrubbing
memories.body: CLI, MCP, transcript ingestion, and consolidation redact credential-shaped values before storage; logs record redaction categories, never matched secret text.
memories.evidence: Every write boundary — CLI, MCP, transcript ingest, consolidation

memories.title: Pending approval
memories.body: With manual governance approval, consolidation-created pages start pending and are invisible to recall until memex approve makes them active.

memories.title: Production ranker
memories.body: Recall uses local SQLite FTS5 with safe bounded query tokens, strict AND first, OR fallback only after no strict result, and deterministic slug ties.

memories.title: Token budget
memories.body: Explicit recall and hook injection pack page text to a token budget. Hits that do not fit are skipped for smaller ones while the top hit is always kept whole.
memories.evidence: Recall and hook injection pack to a token budget

memories.title: Injection relevance floor
memories.body: Hook injection suppresses weak matches rather than filling context with noise. Explicit recall can still return weak hits for inspection.
memories.evidence: Hook injection applies a relevance floor

memories.title: Legacy global write default
memories.body: Older MCP writes used global scope by default when scope was omitted. This historical behavior was superseded by explicit scope selection.

memories.title: Legacy nine MCP tools
memories.body: An older MCP interface exposed import, export, transcript ingestion, and transcript cleanup alongside agent memory tools. This was replaced by the five-tool interface.

memories.title: Other project SQLite authority
memories.body: For an unrelated project, SQLite is the primary durable record and Markdown exports are disposable reports.

memories.title: Other project harness capture
memories.body: For an unrelated project, the agent must call an MCP transcript tool at session end because no lifecycle hook is installed.
